skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of event management and the steps to organize successful events such as conferences and seminars.
Analyze direct and indirect factors influencing the MICE market in Vietnam, regionally, and globally.
Identify factors affecting the organization and management of successful conferences and seminars.
Develop event programs and marketing plans to sell MICE services effectively.
Apply information technology in various stages of MICE management, from operation to management.
